propositions: Canonical contributor guidance in AGENTS.md and .agents/rules/rebar.md hardcodes a specific bot identity (Joe Oakhart) for sign-offs, contradicting CONTRIBUTING.md which requires contributors to sign with their own configured git identity.

Contributors should verify and use their real configured identity (git config user.name/user.email) for DCO sign-offs instead of being prescribed a specific third-party bot identity in general guidance.

A deterministic lint-integrated consistency check must be added to fail the build if hardcoded bot identity strings reappear in contributor-facing documentation, with intentional exclusions for automation-owned paths (infra/, .github/workflows/, tests/, docs/experiments/).

All contributor-facing documentation (AGENTS.md, .agents/rules/*.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/**/*.md excluding experiments) must consistently reference the committer's own configured git identity as the sign-off source.
